READ ME: GLOBAL OCTG | USER GUIDE & TECHNICAL CAVEATS
10 October 2026. Source-backed snapshot of public supplier catalogues; product availability changes.
450 individual supplier/grade records: 15 manufacturers plus API 5CT and API 5CRA reference records.
Open MASTER GRADES. Use Excel table-column dropdowns to filter by supplier, grade, family, corrosion/sour service, SMYS, API group, cost tier, or source.
API 5CT generic grades separate from proprietary designations. M65 is withdrawn; L80-3Cr introduced in newer edition. Check applicable contract edition and errata.
API 5CRA PSL/category/UNS mapping based on the API's August 2023 licensing matrix. API 5CRA 3rd edition was released in 2025: reconfirm grade/category and current requirements before specifying.
Some group 5 age-hardened nickel products are bar-only and NOT casing/tubing; excluded as OCTG grades.
Names on supplier websites may signify a grade, family, minimum yield, or proprietary trademark. Rows report public grade designations and distinguish general family membership.
Sour-service marketing does not mean automatic acceptance under NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156. Verify H2S partial pressure, pH, chloride, temperature, elemental sulfur, stress and environmental limits.
Only treat explicit high-collapse grades as such; a minimum yield strength alone is insufficient for collapse-rating acceptance.
Actual mill OCTG grade-specific prices depend on size, connection, delivery quantity, origin, logistics, and commercial terms; proprietary items therefore show RFQ.
A through I is a qualitative procurement-screening ranking, NOT a quantified material-price ratio or substitute for a supplier quote.
PRICE BENCHMARKS contains separately sourced market examples in USD/t and USD/ft; do not conflate geography, year, grade, delivery basis or units.
Enter nominal weight per foot, joint length, number of joints, USD/t quoted price and other allowances to estimate string cost.
Every master record has a traceable URL and evidence status. SOURCES provides key primary catalogues and standards.
A global proprietary grade portfolio cannot be permanently exhaustive; some supplier catalogues are downloadable PDFs, localized, historical, or sold only by special order.
Check current datasheet, strength/toughness, SSC/SCC/CO2/Cl limits, PSL, manufacturing process, connection, dimensions and applicable service environment.
Native Excel tables support interactive filter/sort in Microsoft Excel; formulas use standard spreadsheet syntax.
